summary: Members who opposed an earlier bill put their names on the revised text when it is introduced.
realLife: Kirsten Gillibrand and Joni Ernst wrote a revised military justice bill together. Several senators who had opposed earlier legislation signed on at introduction.
inGame: The cosponsor-ask scene records a colleague signing a bill. needs: a prior version and that colleague's vote on it.

turns.what: A former opponent agrees to testify for the revision but declines a sponsor credit.
turns.pulledBy: The member supports the change while reserving judgment on another provision.
turns.writesBack: The hearing has a supportive witness without a new sponsor.

turns.what: A former opponent signs after the promised amendment enters the bill.
turns.pulledBy: The disputed wording still stands at introduction.
turns.writesBack: The sponsorship record dates from the amendment.
